contract: GET /api/users/:id. Admin single-user lookup returns its browser view enriched with mediaProgress display fields, preserving nulls and hidden credentials; unknown user returns 404 and non-admin returns 403.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
Mapped tests cover selected denial or lower-level behavior only; successful endpoint payload/state and complete source/client variants need explicit owner-packet assertions.

invariants.contract: GET /api/users/:id as an admin returns the full browser view with all mediaProgress entries (old progress shape plus displayTitle, displaySubtitle for episodes, coverPath and mediaUpdatedAt as an ISO date string) and the bookmarks.
The root user token is shown to root and hidden (empty string) from a non-root admin; users without progress or bookmarks get empty arrays.
GET /api/users/:id answers 401 unauthenticated, 403 to a non-admin for any id including its own, and 404 for an unknown id to an admin.
